name: Cracked Plains
description: A vast plateau shattered by seismic rifts radiating outward from the ancient seal-sites. Deep chasms split the windswept stone, some fifty feet across and a hundred deep, their walls streaked with mineral deposits and bioluminescent fungi. Warlord Drask's bandit army has claimed the ruins of a cliff-fortress here, raiding the lowlands below.

A deep rift yawns before you — fifty feet across at its narrowest, dropping into blue-shadowed darkness. To the east, a half-collapsed stone bridge spans the gap. Below, the rift floor is dimly visible, streaked with bioluminescent moss. Behind you, a precarious descent leads back down to the Ashwood ridge.
